title: The customer page shows the reps with or without an address
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no address and no sales representative; customer {Customer-B} has no address and {Sales-rep-A} as Service Labor and {Sales-rep-B} as Service Parts.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR No Address and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Split No Address.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the page shows "Sales Representative" reading "Unassigned" (not "N/A"), even though the customer has no address.
  • Step 2: the page shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A}, then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R19, S4-E1, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R19: “The customer page shows the representatives with the window's labels, in the window's order: "Sales Representative" or "Sales Representative - Service Labor", then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" when added, then "Sales Representative - Part Sales" when added. An empty one reads "Unassigned". The Sales Representative rows show on every customer, whether or not the customer has an address. The other fields on the page keep today's rule of showing only when the customer has an address.”
  • S4-E1: “On release day every existing customer has the one "Sales Representative" field, with no Service Parts or Part Sales field, and keeps its one representative, so the customer page and every invoice read exactly as before, except that an empty field reads "Unassigned" instead of "N/A".”

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 2 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases.
